How Contra's discovery score works
How Contra's discovery score works
A guide to understanding Contra's discovery score.
Written by
Isabel
October 17, 2025
What is the discovery score?
Your discovery score is an indicator of your reputation on Contra. The higher your score, the greater your visibility on the Discover search page. As your visibility increases, so do your chances of receiving inbound messages from clients and landing high-tier jobs.
​
Because Discover is constantly evolving, your score may adjust over time. It’s designed to give you a clear and actionable view into how your presence on Contra translates to visibility with Clients.
​
What contributes to the discovery score?
Your Discovery Score is calculated on several factors that are weighted differently based on their importance to your reputation.
The score is comprised of factors like your community contributions, profile quality, availability, recommendations & rating, earnings, inquiry response time and how many expert badges you've earned. Being a loyal Contra Pro member can also have a positive impact on your score.
​
There’s no cap on your score, so you can always keep improving!
How can I boost my discovery score?
To see exactly how to boost your score, see your
discovery insights page
.

Direct message (DM) FAQ's
Direct message (DM) FAQ's
Answers to the most frequently asked questions about direct messages on Contra.
Written by
Isabel
March 16, 2026
What are DMs for?
How you use DMs is up to you, but we recommend using direct messages as a way to network, collaborate and share knowledge with others on Contra.
​
It's important to note that DMs are not for pitching your services.
Will users know if I reject their DM?
No, users are not notified if you reject their DM.
Will users know if I mark their DM as spam?
No, users are not notified if you mark their DM as spam.
How do I send my first DM?
To learn how to send your first DM,
see this guide
.
Is there a review process for DMs?
Yes. If you DM someone who is not in your network, your first message them to them will be reviewed by our internal team before it is sent.
Do DMs impact my response rate score? (Independents only)
No, your response rate score is not affected by DMs. You can respond to or ignore DMs without it influencing your score.

How to send a direct message (DM)
Learn how to start a direct message with any user on Contra. Use the steps below to compose and send a message.
Written by
Maggie Shanahan
March 20, 2026
Step 1: Open the Messages window
Click on the "Messages" window in the bottom-right corner of the screen to open the chat window.
Step 2: Click the Compose button
In the top-right corner of the chat window, click the
pencil icon
to start a new message.
Step 3: Search for the recipient
Enter the name or email of the person you want to message. You can message any user on Contra.
Step 4: Write and send your message
Compose your message in the text field and click
Enter
to send.
Additional notes
If the person is not in your network, your message will be reviewed by our internal team before it is sent.
If you haven’t messaged this person before, they’ll need to accept your message before the conversation starts.
How to create a thread
You can also create threaded conversations within your DMs.
Hover over the message you want to start a thread from. Click on the arrow button on the lefthand side of the message to create the thread.
Your threaded replies will be visible under the original message in your conversation history. You can access your thread again at any time by clicking on the number of replies.

How to get your first client on Contra
How to get your first client on Contra
A guide to getting your first client on Contra.
Written by
Isabel
February 24, 2026
Follow this action plan to land your first client and kick off your independent journey on Contra faster.
Step 1:
Build a strong profile
Your profile is your first impression—it’s how potential clients decide whether to reach out or move on.  A great way to do this fast is by posting your work in the community!
Step 2: Invite existing clients
If you already have clients outside of Contra, invite them to start paying you through the platform. This not only streamlines your workflow but also helps you start earning on Contra. As you earn, you’ll unlock your first earnings badge which is an important trust signal that boosts your visibility to new clients.
Bringing existing relationships onto Contra is one of the fastest ways to build momentum and establish your presence.
Step 3: Request reviews
Social proof matters. If you've worked with clients off-platform, you can still showcase those relationships by requesting a review. These reviews appear on your profile and help potential clients feel confident in hiring you, even if you haven’t completed a Contra project yet.
A strong review highlights your reliability and results, which can be the tipping point for a client deciding between candidates.
Learn more about requesting reviews here
.
Step 4: Apply to an expert program
Contra’s expert programs help you stand out by highlighting your proficiency in popular tools. When accepted, you’ll earn an expert badge that displays on your profile and in your job applications.
These badges add instant credibility and make your applications more competitive, especially when clients are looking for specialists in specific tools.
Learn more about expert programs and apply to your first one here.
Step 5: Make applying to jobs a habit
Like most things in life, success on Contra comes down to consistency. Once your profile is crafted, make it a daily habit to visit the job feed and apply to jobs that align with your skills. A well-crafted, personalized application that speaks directly to the client’s needs will help you stand out.
The more you apply, the more chances you create to connect with the right client. Even if you don’t land your first few applications, you're building visibility and learning how to tailor your pitch.
Step 6: Unlock growth with Contra Pro
Contra Pro gives you access to tools that can significantly accelerate your growth on Contra.
Learn more about all Contra Pro features here
.

Onboarding and completing your profile
Onboarding and completing your profile
This guide walks you through onboarding as an Independent on Contra in a few easy steps.
Written by
Isabel
January 27, 2026
Welcome to Contra! We're thrilled to have you join our community of Independents.
We've created this onboarding guide to ensure you hit the ground running 🚀
​
Step 1: What brings you to Contra? ​
Select the type of workspace you would like to create on Contra. If you are an independent looking to share work, get inspired, connect with clients, etc, you'd select
Share work.
If you are a client looking to hire independent's on Contra, you'd select
Hire creative talent.
This onboarding guide is specifically for the independent side of Contra.
Step 2: Upload Your
Profile Photo
For your profile photo, choose a high-quality image where you’re looking approachable and professional. A great profile photo can go a long way in building trust and making connections!
Step 3: Write Your
One-liner
Write a brief but impactful statement that describes what you do and highlights your creative focus. (
Ex:
"Creative Designer helping brands tell their stories").
Need more inspiration? Check out our guide on writing one-liners
here
!
Step 4: Create your account
Once you have completed the above steps you'll be able to create your account. You can sign up for
Contra Pro
or proceed with a free account.
Step 5: Select topics you are interested in
You will see some topics suggested for you based on your one-liner or search for topics you are interested in. You can select as many topics as you'd like. This helps us curate your feed specifically to you!
That's it! Your account is now created on Contra.
Completing your profile on Contra.
Once you have setup your account, you'll need to complete your profile in order to be Discoverable by clients. Here is what's needed in order to complete your profile.
Step 1: Add a profile cover image or video
Choose an image or video that you feel is the
best possible
example of your work. We recommend choosing a high quality image that you think will look great on Discover, or creating a video that’s a highlight reel of your best work.
Step 2: Add 4 pieces of work to your profile
You can add work directly to your profile, from the preview section of the profile completion checklist, or by posting the work on the feed.
Check out this link
for more information on how to add work to your profile by posting to the feed.
Step 3: Add your rate
When it comes to your hourly rate, set a value that reflects your experience and the industry standard. Don’t be shy about valuing your time, your skills are worth it!
Step 4: Share a social link
Adding social links helps build credibility and provides a way for potential clients to learn more about your work before getting in touch. Ideally, one of these is a LinkedIn but you can add links from any platform, including portfolio website links!
Step 5: Verify identity & set up your wallet
Enter all necessary information required for receiving payments on Contra. For more information on setting up your wallet, see our guide
here
!
You're Ready to Start Earning on Contra 💸
Once you've completed this step, you’ve officially onboarded and completed your profile on Contra! You're now
discoverable
, and can start applying to jobs you're matched to 🙌

Using Co-Agent on Contra
Using Co-Agent on Contra
A guide to understanding the Co-Agent feature on Contra.
Written by
Isabel
April 24, 2026
Co-Agent is a personalized agent that helps you manage and scale your freelance business on Contra.
Our goal is for your co-agent to lay the groundwork for any client interaction, and eventually, be where your clients are. Co-Agent should help you harness your AI stack and combine it with the taste you’ve established on Contra and your client work to unlock business scale and earnings.
It also connects to MCPs, so you can bring in your favorite tools and extend what Co-Agent can do for your own workflow. Head over to
Connectors
to connect to your favorite tools.
Co-Agent Intake
Alongside Co-Agent, we’re launching Co-Agent Intake.
​
The core idea is simple: the faster you respond to an inquiry, the more likely it converts. But you can’t always be online. Co-Agent Intake handles that gap: based on your preferences, it steps into the inquiry flow on your behalf, collects the right context from the client about the project, and sends you a clean summary so you’re ready to move the moment you’re back. No more slow starts and losing leads if you’re AFK.
Co-Agent Intake is also customizable: add instructions to guide how the agent interacts, speaks, and qualifies inbound leads.
How to use Co-Agent
If you have Co-Agent access, you will see the "Co-Agent" tab on your left menu navigation under "Home". Click this to start using Co-Agent.
​
You will also be prompted to setup Co-Agent Intake on this page if you have access.
Note: Co-Agent access is being rolled out gradually as we continue improving the experience based on your feedback.

How to build a case study from scratch on Contra
A guide to building profile projects on Contra.
Written by
Isabel
January 14, 2026
Case Studies on Contra are the core to a great profile and are key to providing clients and collaborators a view of your skills, creativity, and expertise. Here's how to create a project from start to finish on Contra.
💡  Pro Tip: You can post to your profile directly from the feed.
Check out this link
for more info.
Step 1: Go to your profile and create a new case study
From your Contra profile, head to the
Work
section and click
Create > Case Study
. This opens the case study creator where you can start building your showcase.
Step 2: Add visual content to showcase your work
Upload an image or videos that highlight the case study to start building your project. The more high quality visuals the better! To add additional visuals, just type "/" in the editor to see all options.
​
Recommended file sizes are 1600 × 1200 (max file size is 200MB for videos and images).
Step 3: Tell the story with a strong description

How to add services to your Contra profile
Written by
Isabel
February 13, 2026
Services on Contra allow you to effectively monetize your best skills. They act as a menu of the skills you want to work on and get paid for. Clients can see what skills you’re offering and send an inquiry, without the hassle of negotiating your rates.
Setting up your services
1. Service
name & cover image
The title of your service should be straight to the point, quickly indicating what you offer. For example, “60-Minute Product Strategy Call” clearly outlines the service without having to expand the service details.

To make your service stand out, you should also add an eye-catching cover image.
2. Service tags
Include search tags to help clients discover your services on Contra’s Services Marketplace. Add 1-3 tags for your Role (ex. Copywriter, 3D Designer, or Product Manager), 1-5 tags for Tools (ex. Notion, Figma, or Loom), and optionally, 1-3 tags for your Industry (ex. Design).

This is where you highlight why someone would want this service. Explain your process, deliverables and list any requirements (what you need from a client to kick off work).

You can price your services as one-time or ongoing (ex. $100/hour, weekly or monthly). Alternatively, you can select "Contact for pricing" if you prefer to give custom quotes to clients.
5. Publish
Finally, hit "Publish" to set your service live on your profile! Or, if you have more details you'd like to add later you can select "Save as unpublished."

Detailing your service offerings on Contra not only helps clients understand your skills and offerings but also streamlines the process of getting hired. Remember to be as specific as possible and include all the critical information to make it easier for clients to choose your services.

Creating a one-liner on Contra is more than just crafting a catchy phrase—it's an opportunity to make a lasting first impression and encourage potential clients to explore your freelance work further. This support guide provides step-by-step instructions on creating a one-liner that effectively communicates your unique value to your ideal clients on Contra.
Locating and Editing Your One-Liner on Contra
You can find your one-liner at the top of your Contra profile under your name. To edit it, simply click on the space that says “Add a professional one-liner”. Then, type in your text and make sure to save your changes once you're done.
Tips for Crafting Your One-Liner
Be Brief but Powerful
Think of your one-liner as a condensed version of your elevator pitch. It should be succinct, memorable, and to the point. Ensure that your one-liner clearly articulates what you do and the value you provide to clients. Stay clear of industry jargon and vague statements.
Showcase Your Personality
Your one-liner should reflect your personality. Whether you're creative, results-oriented, or passionate about a specific niche, use words that mirror who you are. It's also crucial to tailor your one-liner to resonate with your target audience. Think about the tone and language that would most appeal to your ideal clients.
Stimulate Curiosity
Your one-liner should motivate clients to want to know more about you. Ask a provocative question, suggest a benefit, or share a unique aspect of your work that encourages them to click. If you have a specialized niche or expertise, don't hesitate to mention it here. This will help you attract clients who are specifically looking for those skills.
Example One-Liners
Here are few examples of effective one-liners:
"Creative Graphic Designer Specializing in Brand Identity"
"Results-Driven SEO Expert with a Passion for Boosting Organic Traffic"
"Versatile Content Writer Creating Engaging Articles Across Various Niches"

Times hired

Rating
Your rating reflects your overall performance on Contra. It is calculated based on feedback from clients after each completed paid project. Maintaining high-quality work and communication helps improve your rating over time.
Followers
This is the number of people following your Contra profile. You can boost this number by engaging with the Contra community and regularly showcasing your work!

Paid projects
Paid projects
A guide to paid project types, contracts and fees.
Written by
Isabel
Updated over a week ago
Create a project here:
https://contra.com/proposal/new
What is a project on Contra?
A project is a structured agreement between a client and an Independent that defines:
Scope of work
Payment structure
Timeline
Projects are designed for work where you want clear deliverables, payment structure including escrow payments, and dispute assistance if issues arise.
Choosing the right project type
One-Time Fixed (Escrow)
Client pays the total project fee upfront
If there is an upfront amount set, this is released immediately
Funds are held securely
Funds are released once work is approved
Best for new relationships where the project scope is fixed.
One-Time Hourly (Escrow)
Client pays the total project fee upfront (max hours times the rate)
Funds are held securely
Fund are released once hours are submitted and approved
If the hours submitted as less than the max hours, the client is refunded the difference
Best for new relationships where the project scope is based on a hourly commitment
Milestones (Escrow)
Client pays each milestone in full before kicking off
Each milestone is funded and released separately
Funds are held securely
Fund are released once a milestone is submitted and approved
Best for larger projects that can be delivered in phases with the added protection of escrow.
Fixed Invoice Billing
Invoices are automatically generated on a fixed cadence (weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly)
Clients are notified on the invoice date and prompted to pay
Best for established relationship with ongoing work.
Hourly Invoice Billing
Independents submit hours on an ongoing basis, which generates a payable invoice
Clients are notified when hours are submitted and prompted to pay
Best for established relationship with ongoing work based on an hourly commitment
Contract options
Contra offers three contract options:
Contra contract template (default) → Best for standard freelance projects
Locally-compliant contracts → Best for international or region-specific project work
Custom PDF contract → Best if you have your own contract with your own terms
For Contra contract templates and locally compliant contracts, we pre-populate agreements with the project details entered during creation and capture e-signatures.
For custom contracts, clients or Independents can upload their own PDF, and Contra will append the specific payment terms and e-signatures to the contract.
Fees
Fees can be covered by the Independent or the client - a freelancer can choose whether they want to cover Processing & Platform fees during project setup.
See
Fees overview
for the breakdown of all applicable fees.
FAQs
Made a mistake when creating your proposal?
You can click "..." > "Revise" on your proposal page to revise the project before your client signs!
Want to add more onto the project's scope later on?
With
Milestone
projects, can create additional milestones at any point in time, should you and your client wish to add onto the original scope. This can be done by navigating to the project, clicking on the three dots, and selecting "Edit Project".
This is not possible for projects that are one-time fixed payments and aren't milestone-based, but you can always issue a one-off
invoice
and
link it
to your paid project when creating the invoice.
Have extra proposals you want to hide?
You can click "..." > "Archive" on your proposal page to archive the project. This will clear the proposal from your main projects tab and move it to your "
Archived
" tab.
​
Note that project will remain un-archived on the party's account, and if they take an action on the project it will become un-archived on your account as well.
​
This is only available for proposals that have not been countersigned.
What does "Escrow" mean?
Escrow means that the funds are held securely until the independent submits the deliverable and the client approves it. Once the client approves the deliverable, the funds get released to the independent. This ensures that both parties stay in agreement.
Need to cancel your proposal?
If you need to cancel your proposal for any reason, you can click "..." > "End project" to cancel the project. Once a project is cancelled, it can not be re-activated, unlike archived projects.

Applying to jobs on Contra
This is a guide on how to apply for jobs on Contra.
Written by
Isabel
February 24, 2026
Step 1: Browse the feed
Go to the
Job feed
to start discovering opportunities on Contra. From here, you can filter by specific tools, skills and budgets.
Step 2: Apply to jobs
As you browse, you'll see the option to "Apply" or "Dismiss" the job if it is not a good fit.
Step 3: Referring jobs (optional)
See a job that's not perfect for you but is for someone else? You can easily refer the job to them by clicking "Refer & Earn".
Once clicked, this will open up your direct messages so you can send the job to anyone on or off of Contra.
